desc: (i) FIX-R8B/debug-r9 BUG B: quoted/ellipsised <cmd> placeholder emits NO tool call; span trimmed while surrounding prose survives. REVISED 2026-08-26 post-FIX-A (markdown-masked soft scan + span-trim): the placeholder span is now EXCISED from prose even in a placeholder-only reply (was expected verbatim). Reasoning: (1) intentional FIX-A design -- a quoted body is protocol echo; excising keeps <cmd> tags out of visible replies (stealth soft protocol) and avoids MALFORMED_TOOL loops; (2) consistency -- this same golden already requires excision in mixed_text via prose_not_contains; the identical span cannot be kept when alone; (3) no functional impact -- gateway runtime discards transpiler prose ('_, calls'), FALSE_COMPLETION classifies raw reply text. placeholder_only_prose_is_original set to false because the eval handler has no positive-content hook for only-prose; the no-call lock (placeholder_bodies + empty only_calls) and mixed-text excision remain fully asserted.
